description: Git-backed text storage; messaging via file conventions. Every folder has an AGENTS.md (instructions for agents) and a .metatrash.json (settings); read the space root AGENTS.md first.

mcp.tools: tools/list exposes tools only; tools/call uses the shared service.
mcp.accountTools: The OAuth endpoint adds the spaces, pull, pending and push tools. Space arguments there are 'public' or the owner/slug names returned by spaces; space IDs are also accepted. Results name owned spaces by owner/slug. The anonymous /mcp endpoint accepts configured space names only.

authentication.private: Space-scoped bearer key: read permits read/search/list/history; write permits all. Transport credentials only.
authentication.rateControls: Shared limits across clients/transports; admin overrides per space.
authentication.oauth: /mcp/account and /api/v1/account/ require an OAuth access token (Authorization: Bearer) issued for that resource. Access is the public space plus spaces the user consented to, limited by current ownership/membership and the owner's member permission. Space keys are never accepted there; credentials are never accepted in URLs.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a file at the head or a revision; returns the state. Start with AGENTS.md: instructions for agents; each folder has its own. For a long file read only the lines you need with startLine and lineCount (search gives line numbers). To check a file you read before, pass its blob as ifBlob: if it is the same, the answer has unchanged: true and no text. A .metatrash.json that inherits also returns effective: its settings with the parent's filled in. A virtual file (file.virtual: content kept outside Git) returns its text, a PDF or Word file as Markdown, with a note; a picture comes with the result as an image; another file without text returns the note only.

startLine.description: First line (1-based). With startLine or lineCount, text holds only those lines.

lineCount.description: Lines from startLine (default: to the end).

ifBlob.description: Blob from an earlier result: if the file still has it, return unchanged: true without text.

deletable.description: False for a folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json.

virtual.description: Set on a virtual file: content kept outside Git (size, type, source, refresh); read returns its text.

readOnly.description: "agents": agents cannot change, move or delete it; "everyone": nobody can until a person lifts the lock.

blob.description: Git blob hash of the text; pass it to read as ifBlob.

effective.description: Present when the file is a .metatrash.json that inherits: the folder's settings with the inherited ones filled in.

note.description: Present for a virtual file: what its text is, or why it has none.

stale.description: Present when refreshing a virtual file from its source fails: since (RFC 3339) and reason; the text is the last version fetched.

lines.description: Present when startLine or lineCount was given.

end.description: Last line returned; start-1 when none.

unchanged.description: Present (true) when ifBlob matched; text is then empty.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find lines in a space's files, like grep: each match with path, file ID, line number and optional context. Use it to locate text for edit or choose lines to read instead of reading whole files. Virtual files are searched in their text. Plain text, or RE2 with regex.

query.description: Text (or regular expression) to find within one line.

prefix.description: Folder prefix ending in /; empty selects all.

regex.description: Treat query as an RE2 regular expression.

context.description: Lines of context before and after each match.

text.description: The matching line without its line ending, cut to 400 bytes.

truncated.description: More lines matched than limit; narrow the query or prefix.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create a file or replace its whole text. To change part of a file use edit; to add to one use append. Every folder has an AGENTS.md (what it holds and how to work in it; keep it current) and a .metatrash.json (its settings); they come with the folder's first file (write either to make an empty folder), go with its last, and cannot be deleted or moved. A .metatrash.json is checked: a JSON object with optional inherit (true: take the parent's settings but services), purpose (text), children ({"name" or "folder/": text}), readOnly ({"name", "*.pdf" or "folder/": "agents" or "everyone"}), locked ({"key": "agents" or "everyone"}: settings agents or nobody may change), publishedVersion (a whole number; raising it publishes the folder's current files for people to read: only when asked), print ({"image":"https://…"}: an image Slate Viewer prints above the first page's title; only when asked), services ([{"type":"github","repo":"owner/name","branch":"main"}] or [{"type":"acknowledge"}]) and actions ([{"name":"tidy-draft","on":"inbound/*.md","do":"plain-language instructions"}]: an agent pinned to the folder runs once for each file that arrives and records the outcome in runner.md; only when asked); a refusal says which rule. Names starting with a dot are allowed only in a github folder. In a github folder: pull at the start of a session, change files, check pending, then push with a message.

text.description: UTF-8; no NUL; byte limits apply.

ifInState.description: State from read, list or search. state_mismatch only if a file this change touches changed since; then re-read.

strict.description: Refuse if anything in the space changed since ifInState, not only this change's files.

deletable.description: False for a folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json.

virtual.description: Set on a virtual file: content kept outside Git (size, type, source, refresh); read returns its text.

readOnly.description: "agents": agents cannot change, move or delete it; "everyone": nobody can until a person lifts the lock.

blob.description: Git blob hash of the text; pass it to read as ifBlob.

hint.description: Present when this change lies in a GitHub folder whose oldest unpushed change is over 30 minutes old (at most once per 30 minutes per folder): check pending and push when the work is ready.

rebased.description: Present (true) when ifInState was older than the space's state: the change was applied on top of newer changes to other files.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Change part of a file without sending its whole text: each edit replaces oldText, which must match the current text exactly once (include more surrounding text, or set replaceAll), with newText. Edits apply in order, all or none. No ifInState needed: an oldText that no longer matches is refused with conflict; search or read again. LF oldText matches CRLF files. Same rules as write otherwise.

oldText.description: Exact current text to replace, including spaces and line breaks.

replaceAll.description: Replace every match instead of requiring exactly one.

ifInState.description: Optional state: refuse if this file changed since (or anything, with strict).

strict.description: Refuse if anything in the space changed since ifInState, not only this change's files.

tools.name: append
tools.description: Add text to a file without reading it: at the end (creating the file if absent), or before a line with line (1 = top), e.g. a log entry, a note, or the newest entry under a changelog's title. The text starts on a line of its own. No ifInState needed. Same rules as write otherwise.

text.description: Text to add; a line break ends it when it goes before a line.

line.description: Insert before this line (1 = top); leave out to add at the end.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List files and the state; folders are implicit. With since (a state you had), only files added or changed since (with blob) and removed paths, in one answer.

prefix.description: Folder prefix ending in /; empty selects all.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; same other arguments.

since.description: Earlier state: list only what changed since. Not with cursor.

blob.description: Git blob hash of the text; pass it to read as ifBlob.

stale.description: Set on a virtual file whose refreshes from its source are failing: since (RFC 3339) and reason; read says so too.

removed.description: With since: paths removed since then.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move a file in the space, keeping its ID and history. The destination must be absent; no folder moves; AGENTS.md, .metatrash.json and readOnly files never move.

tools.description: Delete a file; old revisions stay readable. A folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json go only with its last other file; readOnly files are refused.

tools.name: history
tools.description: File history across moves and deletes, newest first, with who made each change (by) and, where published, the versions (published). Read old text with an entry's path and revision; for a delete, use the next older entry.

id.description: File ID from read or list.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; same other arguments.

published.description: Versions of the file's folder (publishedVersion) whose text of the file this is.

by.description: Who made the change: name (the account's username, or its email address before the @), app (the app it was made through: Metatrash Sync for a person, the connected app such as Claude for an agent, or space key) and kind (person or agent). Absent on changes before 0.47.0 and on the service's own.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Set where a virtual file comes from and how often it is fetched again, or make one from a URL. source: an http or https URL, fetched now when new or changed (a new version); "" removes the source and refresh. refresh: an every schedule (hour, day 06:00, weekday 08:00, monday 08:00, month 1 09:00, in the space's time zone); "" keeps the current version. A failed refresh keeps the content and read says it is stale.

source.description: http or https URL; "" removes it.

ifInState.description: Optional: state from read, list or search.

strict.description: Refuse if anything in the space changed since ifInState, not only this change's files.

write.note: REST write, move and delete default to strict: true (the whole-space check sync clients rely on); send strict: false for the per-file check MCP uses by default. Edit defaults to the per-file check everywhere.

configure.note: OAuth only (account spaces). Changes a virtual file's source and refresh schedule, or with a source makes one by fetching it; 201 when it made the file. strict defaults to true.

spaces.note: OAuth only. Operation routes are also available as /api/v1/account/spaces/{space}/... where {space} is public, an ID, or {owner}/{slug}.

acknowledgements.note: OAuth only. GET: the caller's published folders and files, and which they still have to read; GET ?report=true: who has read what (read-write access); POST: confirm reading a file's published version (Metatrash Sync only).

errorNotes: state_mismatch includes currentState; rate_limited/queue_full include retryAfterSeconds (REST: Retry-After). MCP errors: isError=true + text JSON; success: structuredContent per outputSchema. conflict comes from edit (an oldText that no longer matches once), from pull and push, and from acknowledgements when the folder has published a newer version; github_unavailable from pull and push.

accountTools.name: spaces
accountTools.description: List the spaces this connection can use and its access to each. Pass a returned space value (owner/slug) to the other tools.

space.description: Value for the space argument: owner/slug, or public.

id.description: Immutable space ID, also accepted as the space argument; absent for the public space.

owner.description: Owner's public username; empty for the public space.

accountTools.name: pull
accountTools.description: Fill or update a GitHub folder (the github service in its .metatrash.json) from its branch; call it at the start of each session. The first pull needs the folder empty apart from .metatrash.json. Files changed here since the last pull or push stay pending unless GitHub changed them too (conflict, naming them). Binaries and files over the space's file limit (up to 100 MB) come in as virtual files where the server keeps them; files Metatrash cannot hold (bad names, too big, or binaries on a server without virtual files) are skipped and listed; UTF-16/32 files are converted and listed. Needs write access.

commit.description: Repository commit the folder now matches.

newState.description: Space state after the pull; equals oldState when upToDate.

upToDate.description: True when the folder already had the branch's latest commit; nothing was written (local changes stay pending).

skipped.description: Repository files not held in the folder (first 50), by path in the repository.

converted.description: Files held as UTF-8 (with a UTF-8 byte order mark) that are UTF-16 or UTF-32 on GitHub (first 50), by path in the space.

localChanges.description: Files changed here since the last pull or push that the pull left in place; they stay pending for push.

accountTools.name: pending
accountTools.description: What push would send from a GitHub folder: files added, modified and deleted since the last pull or push, each with baseState (read the path at it to compare); also notPushed (.gitignore), refused (.github/workflows/) and converted. upToDate: nothing to send. Pass state as ifInState to push to send exactly what you checked.

baseCommit.description: GitHub commit of the last pull or push.

baseState.description: Space revision holding the files of baseCommit (empty if unknown).

state.description: Current space state; pass it to push as ifInState.

oldestChange.description: When the oldest pending change was written, if it can be told.

baseState.description: Space revision holding the previous version; read the path at it to compare. Absent for added files and for files pull skipped.

accountTools.name: push
accountTools.description: Send a GitHub folder's pending changes as one signed commit with your message; check pending first. All or nothing: refused if not pulled, if GitHub moved ahead (pull, then push again), for .github/workflows/ changes, or when the folder's push mode is review. Never forces. Virtual files are sent as their content. Limits: 1000 files, 40 MB of text plus 512 MB of virtual files, 10 pushes per space per 10 minutes.

message.description: Commit message: a short first line, then details if useful.

ifInState.description: Optional state from pending: refuse if a file in the folder changed since.

upToDate.description: Nothing was pending; no commit was made.

parent.description: The commit of the last pull or push, which the new commit follows.

baseState.description: Space revision holding the previous version; read the path at it to compare. Absent for added files and for files pull skipped.

state.description: Space state whose files were pushed.

newState.description: Space state after recording the push.
